cs95...@cs.uwa.edu.au (Peter Gordon WILSMORE) writes:

>have you ever use malkavian madness network and metro underground and
>homonculi. before your turn bleed ( bleed moderfiers and stealth) during
>your turn bleed untap after your tur bleed.

I haven't used this combo personally, but to clarify:

MMN: Malks act after the minion phase of any turn (before the influence phase).
MetroU: untap at the end of your turn (after discard) Pay one pool and Tap MU.
Homunculus: during any players untap (I believe).

Your turn:
Untap.
Master.
Minion phase: Malk 1 bleeds Prey.
End Minion Phase: Malk 2 bleeds Prey thru MMN.
Influence.
Discard.
End Turn: Malk 1 untaps thru MetroU (you spend one pool).
Prey's turn:
Untap: Malk 2 untaps thru Homunculus (he spends one blood).
Minion Phase.
End Minion Phase: Malks 1 and 2 bleed Prey (separately).
Influence.
Discard.
End Turn: can't use MetroU, because it is tapped.
etc.
